name: @xhis/ldap-identity
description: A real, LDAP/Active-Directory-backed IdentityProvider -- a refreshable in-memory cache behind a synchronous resolve(), so @xhis/core's IdentityProvider contract (and every one of its dozens of existing synchronous call sites) never has to become async just for this. Built only on @xhis/core's public export surface, same as @xhis/xguard and @xhis/postgres-shell; @xhis/core itself stays dependency-free.
